data.title: Reprogramming robots in the mud: How Army Special Ops trains its new robot technicians - Breaking Defense
data.description: “What we’re building is a soldier that can adapt a piece of robotic kit to the mission, to the enemy, to the terrain,” said Maj. Gen. Jason Slider, commander of the John F. Kennedy Special Warfare Center and School.
data.author: Sydney J. Freedberg Jr.
